shots.focal_element: Feature title 'AI Agent Builder' under a dark 'INTRODUCING' pill
shots.typography: Small all-caps sans label with slight positive tracking inside a dark rounded pill; large white geometric sans title in title case, regular-to-medium weight, tight tracking
shots.what_happens: On a soft diagonal-gradient green field a small dark dot appears top-centre, expands horizontally into the 'INTRODUCING' pill, then the white title 'AI Agent Builder' fades/rises in below it while the VO says 'With our AI Agent Builder' (w155-w159).
shots.build_rebuild: Render a full-bleed linear gradient, scale a 24px dark circle into a pill (width tween, ease-out) whose label fades in, then fade-and-rise the centred title 0.5s later, timed to word w157.

shots.focal_element: Procedure text box being filled in the 'AI Agent Builder' window
on_screen_text: To get started, share your Reward Status procedure steps and any other information you think is relevant and we'll start there.
Thanks, to check the status of a reward, the AI agent should:
Collect and validate the user's email address, then verify their identity by sending a confirmation email.
Once the user provides the verification code, authenticate them and retrieve their purchase history.
Identify eligible purchases for rewards and prompt the user to confirm the specific purchase.
Finally, check and display the reward status.
shots.typography: Simplified recreated UI: light sans app title in a dark header bar, small medium-weight section headings, regular-weight body copy in sentence case; app chrome rather than display type
shots.what_happens: A floating, rounded app window on a dark green field (with a lighter green border frame) shows a 'Create procedure' panel; the procedure text types on line by line in the input while an oversized cursor idles on the empty canvas, then moves down and clicks the purple 'Create procedure' button as the VO says 'describe your business procedures' (w160-w176). The window gently scales/drifts across the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a rounded UI card with drop shadow centred on a dark background, type the procedure text into a bordered textarea at a steady characters-per-second rate, then animate a large cursor to the button and play a press state at the end of the shot.

shots.focal_element: Auto-generated conversation-flow diagram on a dotted canvas
on_screen_text: Ask for the visitor's email address
Inform that the email format is invalid. Request for a valid email address.
Inform the visitor that a verification code has been sent to their email address
shots.typography: Small UI sans: medium-weight node type labels (Instruction, Condition, Integration) above regular-weight sentence-case descriptions, monospace variable tags ('email', 'API-verificationEmail')
shots.what_happens: The canvas widens to fill most of the frame; a 'Start' node appears, then the 'Collect and validate email' group of colour-coded nodes builds in, followed by further groups ('Verify user' and one more) appearing to the right in sequence while the cursor rests bottom-right; VO 'the AI will build up the conversation flow for you, without any scripting or training' (w166-w181).
shots.build_rebuild: On a dotted-grid canvas card, reveal flowchart groups left-to-right with a short fade/scale-in per group (about 0.5-1s apart), each group containing pastel-tinted node cards linked by thin connector lines with True/False labels.

shots.focal_element: Feature title 'AI Reasoning Controls' under the 'INTRODUCING' pill

shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the s006 chapter-card component with a new title string, adding two out-of-focus background shapes (large blur radius, low opacity) at the frame edges.

shots.focal_element: 'AI agent builder' form with Procedure, Chain of thought and Reasoning controls fields
on_screen_text: Collect email address from user and validate email format
Prompt user verification by sending verification email [API-Send verification email]
Ask user to look up and provide verification code from email
Ask user to confirm purchase in question and check status of reward [API-Check reward status]
Task: Retrieve past transactions. Validate cashback status.
Cashback ineligible due to third party merchant processing.
Expanded question: Has the vendor who processed the purchase been pre-approved?
Tell us what you'd like to change

Use a friendly, empathetic tone. Apologize for any inconveniences and reassure the customer you're here to help. Also escalate to a human agent if any transaction data seems inconsistent or fraudulent.
shots.typography: Product-style UI: semibold sans page title, medium-weight section headings in sentence case, small regular bulleted body text, italic grey helper text under 'Reasoning controls'; purple filled primary button
shots.what_happens: A long static hold on a Zendesk-styled admin window (dark icon sidebar with a highlighted mint item) on the dark green field: the Chain of thought list populates (~1:20), then the Reasoning controls instruction appears (~1:23.5) and the Procedure bullets fill in (~1:24); the rest of the shot holds unchanged while the VO explains visibility, refinement and guardrails (w189-w233). Anchors list 0 events. The last sampled frame (1:35.5) already shows a light-green background with an 'AI agent' panel, i.e. the next shot's look.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a rounded, shadowed admin-form card centred on a dark background and pop in the content of three textareas one after another (fade per block, about 2-4s apart), then hold the completed form under the VO.
